experiments.question: Can an endpoint starch test distinguish enzyme-treated starch from intact starch and a maltose negative control?

experiments.title: A missing chromatographic peak does not prove a missing ingredient
experiments.title_de: Ein fehlender chromatographischer Peak beweist kein fehlendes Ingredient
experiments.question: What is lost when a neutral-partition chromatogram is treated as a complete analysis of a sample containing ions and unresolved protein?

# D3-BD-004: A missing chromatographic peak does not prove a missing ingredient
# Simulation candidate; no runtime observations are claimed.
register lv3
add v1 water 40mL
add v1 ethanol 0.001mol
add v1 NaCl 0.001mol
add v1 albumin 0.2g
chromatograph v1
measure v1 conductivity
measure v1 balance
particles v1
inspect
experiments.expected_result: Compare the peak list with the independent salt and unresolved-protein inventories. A plot that includes ethanol cannot certify absence of the other ingredients, whether or not every omission is explicitly labelled by the instrument.
limitations: The neutral chromatography sampler has limited phase and identity coverage. Material aggregates may be outside its peak mechanism altogether; this is not a failure of matter conservation by itself.
